conjugation_note: The true C3-M1 convention uses c_k=(a_k+i*b_k)/2. This script input negates b and db, giving the conjugate-transpose Toeplitz kernels. All principal event determinants and entropy-rate bounds are unchanged.
margin_note: For |t|<=1/4, |c1(t)|=|c2(t)|=(3/25)*sqrt(1+t^2), so oscillation <=3*sqrt(17)/25. The sharper exact margin is greater than 1/200.
